parameters.message:
=Review the FishPin ad above (`{{ $('Pick Row').first().json.row.id }}`, attempt {{ $('Pick Row').first().json.attempt }} of {{ $('Config').first().json.maxAttempts }}, {{ $('Collect Photos').first().json.image_count }} image(s)).

*Decline* throws it away and regenerates the copy and images for the same idea.
